title: cephalaria decurrens
intro: Cephalaria decurrens, commonly known as the Dalmatian bugloss or Dalmatian toadflax, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Caprifoliaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cephalaria decurrens are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. Additionally, the plant has been reported to have hepatoprotective and antiviral properties, making it a promising candidate for the development of new medicinal agents.
